chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn al-Hasan al-Baghdadi narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Aziz (dictating) narrated to us, saying: Bishr ibn al-Walid narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Talha narrated from al-A'mash, from Atiyyah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his Family) said:

Indeed, I am about to be called and I will respond. So I am leaving among you the Two Weighty Things: The Book of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, and my Family (Ahl al-Bayt). The Book of Allah is a Rope extended between Heaven and earth, and my Family is my Household. Indeed, the All-Kind, the All-Acquainted, informed me that they will never be separated until they meet me at the Basin. So look into by what you will succeed me.
ai.seo_question: What are the Two Weighty Things left by the Prophet and what is their relationship?
ai.summary: This foundational Hadith al-Thaqalayn, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, establishes the inseparable nature of the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt as dual sources of guidance that will not diverge until the Day of Judgment. It underscores the Shia doctrine of the Prophet's explicit designation of his progeny as the living interpretation of the Divine Book, urging the community to prevent them from being left behind in matters of faith.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Ja’far bin Hasan al-Baghdadi, that he said: We were told by Abdullah bin Muhammed bin Abdul-Aziz, dictating, that he said: We were told by Bishr bin Walid, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Talha, from A’mash, from ‘Atiya bin Sa’eed, from Abu Sa’eed al-Khudri, that the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said:

Indeed, I am about to be called, to which I will respond. Hence, I am leaving among you the Two Weighty Things: The Book of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He; and my Family. The Book of Allah is a Rope extended between Heaven and earth, and my Family, my Household. Indeed, the All-Kind, the All-Acquainted, informed me that they are never to be separated until they meet me at the basin. Thus, look into by what you will succeed me.
